title: Unity Gateway API and developer tools are generally available
body:
The Unity Gateway API for managing model services, model provider services, and MCP services is now generally available, with create, read, update, list, and delete support across Databricks developer tools:

* [Terraform provider](/aws/en/dev-tools/terraform): 1.132.0 and later
* [Databricks CLI](/aws/en/dev-tools/cli/install): v1.17.0 and later
* [Python SDK](/aws/en/dev-tools/sdk-python): `databricks-sdk` 0.136.0 and later
* [Go SDK](/aws/en/dev-tools/sdk-go): `databricks-sdk-go` v0.178.0 and later
* [Java SDK](/aws/en/dev-tools/sdk-java): `databricks-sdk-java` 0.153.0 and later
* [JavaScript SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@databricks/sdk-aigateway): `@databricks/sdk-aigateway` 0.19.0 and later

[Declarative Automation Bundles](/aws/en/dev-tools/bundles) support, through the Databricks CLI 1.17.0 and later, is in Beta.

For API documentation, see the [Unity Gateway API reference](https://docs.databricks.com/api/workspace/aigateway).

For examples and tutorials, see the following:

* [Create and manage model APIs (model services)](/aws/en/ai-gateway/create-model-services)
* [Create and manage external model providers (model provider services)](/aws/en/ai-gateway/create-model-provider-services)
* [Register an external MCP server](/aws/en/ai-gateway/register-mcp-service).
